## LLM015 Transactional method returns Flux/Mono

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm015 |
| Turn it off | `LLM015: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM015` on the command line |

A blocking transaction manager commits the moment the method returns. In a method that returns Flux/Mono the real work happens on subscription — by then the code runs outside the transaction. It looks like @Transactional, but rollback never happens.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM015` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm015 -->

## What it looks like

A `@Transactional` method whose return type is `Flux` / `Mono`.

## How to fix

Let the reactive chain run outside the transaction, or collect it with a short timeout and commit eagerly. As written the transaction closes before the work happens.
